mentions.name: YunoHost self-hosting setup
mentions.description: A self-hosted home server set up with YunoHost, running Immich for photos and Actual Budget for budgeting; the author notes it is easy enough to set up on Linux even without an IT background.
mentions.source_excerpt: Selfhosting via yunohost, especially loving Immich and Actual Budget. I'm not in IT but I use Linux and it has been easy enough for me to set up.
